description: This PHP class defines a client for interacting with the Amazon WorkMail Message Flow service, providing methods to get and put raw message content both synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.name: WorkMailMessageFlowClient
classes.description: A client class for Amazon WorkMail Message Flow service, utilizing methods inherited from AwsClient.

methods.name: getRawMessageContent
methods.description: Retrieves the raw message content from the service.

methods.name: getRawMessageContentAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the raw message content from the service.

methods.name: putRawMessageContent
methods.description: Sends raw message content to the service.

methods.name: putRawMessageContentAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sends raw message content to the service.
